name: sure-media
description: Sure Media - IPO & Stock Broker Portal

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.start: npm run db:setup && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:generate --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
